$comment: LinkedIn post rubric. Consumed by src/sensor.js. Adding a new dim = (a) add an entry here, (b) register an evaluator in src/sensor.js. See tests/test-sensor.js for expected behaviour.

length.$comment: Total chars + sentence count must both be in range.

first_line_hook.$comment: First line must be short and not start with a clichéd opener.

formatting.$comment: Paragraph breaks (blank lines). Each paragraph must be <=3 sentences.

hashtag_count.$comment: Hashtags like #word. Each must be single lowercase word.

no_engagement_bait.$comment: Banned closings. Case-insensitive. Match anywhere in last paragraph or at end.

no_all_caps_words.$comment: No ALL-CAPS words >3 chars (acronyms of 3 or fewer allowed).

no_unsupported_claims.$comment: Numbers, employer names, tool names, specific metrics in the draft must appear in the user-provided facts. Implemented in src/facts.js (claim extraction + diff).
